description: This file defines a generic linked list data structure and associated macros, inline functions, and iterator API for list manipulation in C.

methods.name: __ds_list_init
methods.description: Inline function to initialize a list with a given offset.

methods.name: ds_list_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: ds_list_next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the list.

methods.name: ds_list_head
methods.description: Returns the head element of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_tail
methods.description: Returns the tail element of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_insert_head
methods.description: Inserts a new element at the head of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_insert_tail
methods.description: Inserts a new element at the tail of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts a new element after a specified element.

methods.name: ds_list_remove_after
methods.description: Removes the element after a specified element.

methods.name: ds_list_remove_head
methods.description: Removes the head element of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_ifirst
methods.description: Initializes an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: ds_list_inext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element.

methods.name: ds_list_iinsert
methods.description: Inserts an element at the iterator position.

methods.name: ds_list_iremove
methods.description: Removes the element at the iterator position.
